title: Place value and operations
curriculumNote: Core signed/fraction/decimal arithmetic is assumed continuously.

title: Prime factors, HCF and LCM
curriculumNote: Y8 switches to prime-factor methods.

title: Fractions and mixed numbers
curriculumNote: Y8 adds fraction division and recurring-decimal foundations.

title: Decimals, rounding and percentages
curriculumNote: Y9 extends to significant figures, standard form and compound change.

title: Ratio and proportion
curriculumNote: Higher adds direct/inverse algebraic proportion.

title: Index laws and standard form
curriculumNote: Fractional indices at Higher and AS.

title: Surds
curriculumNote: Do not treat surd manipulation as Foundation content.

title: Bounds and error intervals
curriculumNote: Y9 checklist does not explicitly state formal bounds.

title: Expressions, substitution, single brackets
curriculumNote: Core fluency before equations.

title: Linear equations and rearranging
curriculumNote: Year 7 checklist has expressions/formulae but not explicit linear solving.

title: Common factor and polynomial expansion
curriculumNote: Progresses from one to two to three brackets.

title: Quadratics and discriminant
curriculumNote: Discriminant and parameter questions are A level Year 1.

title: Linear and quadratic inequalities
curriculumNote: Quadratic inequalities are Higher and AS.

title: Simultaneous equations
curriculumNote: Year 9 linear-linear; Higher adds linear-quadratic.

title: Algebraic fractions / partial fractions
curriculumNote: Partial fractions are taught for full 9MA0, not 8MA0.

title: Function notation, domain and range
curriculumNote: AS graphs use functions; full A level adds more formal algebra.

title: Composite and inverse functions
curriculumNote: Basic function composition at Higher; increased sophistication at full A level.

title: Modulus graphs and equations
curriculumNote: Full 9MA0 extension.

title: Arithmetic nth term
curriculumNote: Year 7 begins, Year 9 revisits.

title: Quadratic and geometric patterns
curriculumNote: KS3 exposure is not the same as formal A level series.

title: Arithmetic/geometric series, sigma
curriculumNote: Formal arithmetic and geometric series and sigma notation are 9MA0 scope, taught as a chapter by JIS Y13; KS3 number patterns earlier.

title: Binomial expansion
curriculumNote: Fractional/negative power expansions are additional full 9MA0 content.

title: Coordinates, tables and linear graphs
curriculumNote: JIS Year 7 already plots y=mx+c using a table.

title: Gradient and equations of lines
curriculumNote: Y8 is the explicit gradient focus.

title: Real-life graphs / kinematics
curriculumNote: Avoid confusing distance-time slope with velocity-time area.

title: Quadratic, cubic, reciprocal graphs
curriculumNote: Year 9 plots simple quadratics; IGCSE Higher extends range.

title: Graph transformations and modelling
curriculumNote: High reuse for website visual and investigation modes.

title: Angles, triangles and polygons
curriculumNote: Explicit years 7 and 8.

title: Properties of 2D/3D shapes and nets
curriculumNote: Year 9 adds right-prism and circle/cylinder measures.

title: Perimeter, area, surface area, volume
curriculumNote: Higher extends cones, spheres and similarity measures.

title: Constructions, bearings and scale
curriculumNote: Year 9 checklist explicitly targets constructions and bearings.

title: Transformations and enlargement
curriculumNote: Year 9 introduces negative/fractional enlargement in its checklist.

title: Congruence and similarity
curriculumNote: Area-volume scale factors at Higher.

title: Pythagoras and right-angle trig
curriculumNote: Year 9 introduces both explicitly.

title: Sine/cosine rules, 3D trig
curriculumNote: A level assumes much of Higher geometry.

title: Circle vocabulary, chords and tangents
curriculumNote: Higher adds full circle theorems.

title: Circle theorems and sector measures
curriculumNote: IGCSE Higher circle theorems; Year12 JIS includes radians/sector formulae in Pure2 Ch5.

title: Translation column vectors
curriculumNote: Year 9 checklist uses vector translations.

title: Vector algebra and proofs
curriculumNote: A level extends to 3D.

title: Averages, range, tables and bar charts
curriculumNote: Revisit representation before using standard deviation.

title: Scatter plots, correlation, regression
curriculumNote: Formal PMCC hypothesis test is full A level.

title: Histograms, CF, quartiles and IQR
curriculumNote: Foundation does not include unequal-class histogram methods.

title: Sampling and large data set
curriculumNote: Need JIS local confirmation on applied sequencing.

title: Standard deviation and data critique
curriculumNote: AS applied skill.

title: Simple, Venn and sample-space probability
curriculumNote: Year 8 checklist focuses relative frequency.

title: Tree and conditional probability
curriculumNote: Higher prerequisite for A level probability.

title: Binomial and normal distributions
curriculumNote: Normal is full A level; binomial is AS.

title: Hypothesis testing
curriculumNote: Binomial in AS; Normal mean and correlation in full 9MA0.

title: First principles and differentiating powers
curriculumNote: Higher includes simple polynomial derivative, not integration.

title: Tangents, normals, stationary points
curriculumNote: A level Year 1 develops methods and optimisation.

title: Chain, product, quotient and implicit
curriculumNote: 9MA0 extra scope includes all; at JIS product/quotient/chain are brought forward to Year12.

title: Integration and area
curriculumNote: AS first integration; full A level multiple methods.

title: Differential equations
curriculumNote: Separable differential equations in full 9MA0.

title: Numerical roots and integration
curriculumNote: Iteration/Newton–Raphson/trapezium rule.

title: Exponentials and logarithms
curriculumNote: AS introduces models; full A level builds calculus with logs.

title: Radians and compound-angle identities
curriculumNote: Do not put radian measure in the IGCSE trigonometry generator.

title: SI units and vector quantities
curriculumNote: Units and modelling language.

title: Graphs, SUVAT and forces
curriculumNote: Year 8 real-life graphs are background, not A level mechanics.

title: Projectiles, variable acceleration
curriculumNote: Full A level extension.

title: Friction, moments and inclined planes
curriculumNote: Full A level extension.
